Team —

Attached is the latest runway tracker (runway_tracker_v4.xlsx) ahead of next week’s QBR prep. I pulled together the crossfunc items that execs will ask about during the review; top of mind: production rollout readiness, customer-impacting exceptions, any outstanding procurement/legal delays for ACME.

Please do the following by EOD Wednesday (Dec 15):
- Update the tracker row you own with status, next-step, and concrete date.
- Flag any item that requires an exec decision or SLA exception and add a one-line rationale.
- If blocked by security/compliance, paste the questionnaire link + point contact.

Key items called out in the sheet:
1) ACME dedicated capacity contract (Procurement + Legal)
2) Canary rollout for 1.3 optimizer (Prod + Infra)
3) SOC2 evidence for customer audit (Security)
4) Billing/discount ask for ACME renewal

I’ll consolidate updates Thu morning and produce the executive one-pager. If you can’t meet the Wednesday ask, call out a target date now — I’ll escalate only for things still open by Thu EOD.

Thanks,
Jonas

Great progress — thank you all for the quick updates. Consolidating next steps here so I can build the exec one-pager:

- Legal: confirm redaction rule for log export (owner: Legal@redwood.com) — due Tue COB (2026-12-15). If not confirmed, confirm scoped canary exclusion for ACME by Wed COB.
- Infra (Vivek): prepare capacity config and exclusion filter — due 2026-12-20.
- Security (Karthik): prepare SOC2 export and handoff to ACME (conditional on Legal) — due 2026-12-16.
- CS (Marissa): finalize billing concession bands and prepare one-slide rationale for execs — due 2026-12-16.
- PM (Lauren): draft 1-paragraph exec slate justifying the SLA exception + rollback plan — due 2026-12-16.

Exec asks for the QBR deck (what I will present):
- One-slide summary of ACME status (contract, security audit, billing concession ask, recommended exec decision).
- Canary readiness scorecard (green/amber/red) — we will mark amber unless Legal confirms redaction by Tue.
- Proposed mitigation (scoped canary + rollback) and timeline.

If any owner cannot meet the listed date, please reply with a firm alternative. I’ll drive escalation to Procurement or execs only if we do not have a reassigned owner by Thu morning.

I’m attaching the consolidated tracker I’ll use for the QBR prep. I’ll share the one-pager by Thu 9AM.
